scenarios.name: paired-lookout-draws-on-combat-damage
scenarios.why: With both creatures controlled and unpaired as they enter, the soulbond choice pairs them. The paired Lookout gains the damage-triggered draw ability, so its unblocked attack draws one card.

scenarios.name: unpaired-lookout-does-not-draw-on-combat-damage
scenarios.why: With no other creature to pair with, the Lookout has no granted damage-triggered ability; combat damage alone does not draw a card.
